voice: Fail this test, and the whole truck goes back. Here's how to run it right.
Damp cone, damp base plate. Stand on the foot pieces so it can't lift.
Fill it in three layers, each one a third of the volume. Twenty-five strokes per layer.
Now the step most crews get wrong.
Lift straight up in about five seconds. No twist, no jerk.
Flip the cone, lay the rod across, and measure down to the center of the top. Four inches.
The ticket says four. Under A S T M C ninety-four, three to five passes. Seven? Call the plant before anyone adds water.
Part three is that water problem. Follow so you catch it.
